en.headline: IVE stages three Hong Kong arena nights from Friday
en.dek: The South Korean group's Show What I Am world tour plays AsiaWorld-Arena on 4, 5 and 6 September, with an 8pm start on Friday and 6pm on the weekend.
body: South Korean group IVE is listed for three concerts at AsiaWorld-Arena from Friday to Sunday under the tour title Show What I Am in Hong Kong.

Live Nation Hong Kong lists the dates as 4, 5 and 6 September at AsiaWorld-Arena. The promoter's listing gives Friday's start as 8pm and the Saturday and Sunday shows as 6pm. Seated tickets are listed from HK$799 to HK$2,299, with the top tier described as a VIP package that includes a pre-show soundcheck.

The listing states seated zones are for people aged three or above. Tickets went on public sale in April through the promoter's channels. The run is one of several large pop dates booked at the airport-side arena in September.

zh.headline: IVE香港站周五起一連三場亞博Arena
zh.dek: 韓國組合IVE世界巡演《SHOW WHAT I AM》定於9月4至6日在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行，周五晚上8時、周末晚上6時開場。
body: 韓國組合IVE將於星期五至日在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行三場香港站演唱會，巡演名稱為Show What I Am。
Live Nation香港節目表列出日期為9月4日、5日及6日，場地為AsiaWorld-Arena。官方資料顯示周五晚上8時開場，周六及周日則為晚上6時。坐票列為799元至2,299元，最高一檔為含演前Soundcheck的VIP套票。
節目表註明座位區只適合3歲或以上人士。門票較早前已於4月公開發售。九月亞博場館另有多場大型流行音樂會檔期。
